finding: A written Substack Note (plain text, an opinion about something a reader can use) is the one post that brought a subscriber; image cross-posts pasted into Notes reach almost nobody.

evidence.result: Note "The interesting bit of Claude Duet is who starts the work" (4 Nov): reach 208 against a Notes median of 4, 8 interactions, 1 free subscription in Buffer. Six image cross-posts on Notes: median reach 4, no subscriber.

revisit_when: After a week of one written Note a day: subscriptions per Note against image cross-posts.
